SELECT B.coverImg, B.title, B.author, B.publisher, LB.lbidx, LB.code, LB.callName, LB.location, LB.dueDate, LB.status FROM LIBRARYBOOKS AS LB JOIN BOOKS AS B ON LB.bidx = B.bidx WHERE B.delyn = 'N' AND LB.delyn = 'N'
ORDER BY LB.lbidx LIMIT #{startPageNum}, #{perPageNum};
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM LIBRARYBOOKS AS LB JOIN BOOKS AS B ON LB.bidx = B.bidx WHERE B.delyn = 'N' AND LB.delyn = 'N'
SELECT * FROM LIBRARYBOOKS AS LB JOIN BOOKS AS B ON LB.bidx = B.bidx JOIN CATEGORY AS C ON LB.cidx = C.cidx WHERE B.delyn = 'N' AND LB.delyn = 'N' AND lbidx = #{lbidx};
